translations.idiomatic: Three days later the army camped at Changshan, fifteen li from the city, where twenty thousand Great Qing cavalry rode out to engage them.

sentences.zh: 兩軍交鋒，火器競發，聲震天地。

translations.literal: The two armies clashed; firearms fired one after another, and the sound shook heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies collided as firearms roared in rapid succession, the noise thundering across the field.

sentences.zh: 春營被沖，諸軍遂敗，襄先敗，春復收潰眾立營。

translations.literal: Chun's camp was broken through, and the armies were then defeated; Xiang was defeated first, and Chun again gathered the scattered troops and established a camp.
translations.idiomatic: Chun's camp was overrun and the army broke; Xiang's force fell first, but Chun rallied the fugitives and re-formed a camp.

sentences.zh: 時風起，黑雲見，春命縱火，風順，火甚熾，天忽雨反風，士卒焚死甚眾。

translations.literal: At the time the wind rose and black clouds appeared; Chun ordered fires set, and with the wind favorable the flames burned fiercely; heaven suddenly rained and the wind reversed, and very many soldiers were burned to death.
translations.idiomatic: Wind sprang up and black clouds gathered; Chun ordered troops to set fires, and with the wind behind them the blaze spread fiercely—then rain fell and the wind shifted, and a great many soldiers perished in the flames.

sentences.zh: 少頃雨霽，兩軍復鏖戰，偉力不支亦走。

translations.literal: Before long the rain cleared, and the two armies fought fiercely again; Wei could not hold and also fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the rain lifted the two armies clashed again, but Wei could not hold the line and fled as well.

sentences.zh: 春及參將張洪謨、楊華徵，遊擊薛大湖等三十三人俱被執，部卒死者無算。

translations.literal: Chun, together with Assistant Generals Zhang Hongmo and Yang Huazheng, Guerrilla Commander Xue Dahu, and thirty-three others in all, were all captured; the number of soldiers in the ranks who died was beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Chun, Assistant Generals Zhang Hongmo and Yang Huazheng, Guerrilla Commander Xue Dahu, and thirty others were all taken captive; untold numbers of rank-and-file soldiers perished.

sentences.zh: 諸人見我太宗文皇帝皆行臣禮，春獨植立不跪。

translations.literal: When the others saw Our Taizong Wen Emperor they all performed the rites of subjects; Chun alone stood upright and would not kneel.
translations.idiomatic: All the others bowed as subjects before Our Taizong Wen Emperor; Chun alone stood upright and refused to kneel.

sentences.zh: 至晚，遣使賜以珍饌。

translations.literal: By evening an envoy was sent to bestow delicacies upon him.
translations.idiomatic: That evening an envoy was sent with delicacies as a gift.

sentences.zh: 春曰：「忠臣不事二君，禮也。

translations.literal: Chun said: "A loyal minister does not serve two rulers—that is the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Chun said: "A loyal minister serves only one ruler—that is propriety.

sentences.zh: 我若貪生，亦安用我。

translations.literal: If I wished only to live, of what use would I be to you?"
translations.idiomatic: If I wished only to live, what use would you have for me?"

sentences.zh: 」遂不食。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ate nothing.
translations.idiomatic: He then refused to eat.

sentences.zh: 越三日，復以酒饌賜之，春仍不食，守者懇勸，感太宗文皇帝恩，始一食。

translations.literal: Three days later wine and food were again bestowed upon him; Chun still ate nothing, but the guards earnestly urged him, and moved by Our Taizong Wen Emperor's grace he ate once.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later wine and food were sent again; he still refused until the guards earnestly urged him and, moved by the emperor's grace, he ate once.

sentences.zh: 令發，不從。

translations.literal: When ordered to depart, he would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: When ordered to leave, he would not comply.

sentences.zh: 居右廟，服故衣冠，迄不失臣節而死。

translations.literal: He dwelt in the Right Temple, wearing his former cap and robes, and died to the end without losing the integrity of a minister.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in the Right Temple in his old robes and cap and died without ever abandoning his loyalty as a minister.

sentences.zh: 初，襄等敗書聞，以春守志不屈，遙遷右副都御史，恤其家。

translations.literal: Earlier, when word of Xiang's defeat arrived, because Chun had held to his resolve and not submitted, he was remotely promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and his family was granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: When news of Xiang's defeat reached the court, Chun was remotely promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and his family granted relief for his unbroken resolve.

sentences.zh: 春妻翟聞之，慟哭，六日不食，自縊死。

translations.literal: When Chun's wife Zhai heard of it, she wailed in grief, went six days without eating, and hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: Chun's wife Zhai, on hearing this, wailed in grief, went six days without eating, and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 當春未死時，我大清有議和意，春為言之於朝，朝中嘩然詆春。

translations.literal: While Chun had not yet died, the Great Qing had an inclination toward peace talks; Chun spoke of this in court, and the court erupted in uproar denouncing Chun.
translations.idiomatic: While Chun was still alive the Great Qing had been inclined toward peace talks; he relayed this to court, and the court erupted in denunciation of him.

sentences.zh: 誠意伯劉孔昭遂劾春降敵不忠，乞削其所授憲職。

translations.literal: Liu Kongzhao, Earl of Chengyi, thereupon impeached Chun for surrendering to the enemy and disloyalty, requesting that the legal office granted him be stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kongzhao, Earl of Chengyi, thereupon impeached Chun for surrendering to the enemy and disloyalty, requesting that his legal office be stripped away.

sentences.zh: 朝議雖不從，而有司系其二子死於獄。

translations.literal: Although court deliberation did not accept this, the relevant officials imprisoned his two sons, and they died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Although court opinion did not accept this, the relevant officials imprisoned his two sons, and they died in jail.

sentences.zh: 閻生斗，字文瀾，汾西人。

translations.literal: Yan Shengdou, courtesy name Wenlan, was a native of Fenxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shengdou, styled Wenlan, was a native of Fenxi.

sentences.zh: 由歲貢生，歷保安知州。

translations.literal: Entering through the annual tribute student route, he served as magistrate of Bao'an.
translations.idiomatic: He entered through the annual tribute student route and served as magistrate of Bao'an.

sentences.zh: 大清兵入保安，生斗集吏民固守。

translations.literal: When Great Qing troops entered Bao'an, Shengdou gathered clerks and people to hold firm in defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Great Qing troops entered Bao'an, Shengdou gathered clerks and townspeople to hold the defense.

sentences.zh: 城破，被執死之。

translations.literal: When the city fell he was captured and put to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 判官李師聖、吏目王本立、訓導張文魁亦同死，時崇禎七年七月也。

translations.literal: Assistant Magistrate Li Shisheng, Clerk Wang Benli, and Instructor Zhang Wenkui also died together with him; it was the seventh month of the seventh year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Magistrate Li Shisheng, Clerk Wang Benli, and Instructor Zhang Wenkui also died together—this was in the seventh month of the seventh year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 八月入靈丘，知縣蔣秉采募兵堅守，力屈眾潰，投繯死，合門殉之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they entered Lingqiu; Magistrate Jiang Bingcai raised troops and defended resolutely; when strength gave out the crowd dispersed; he hanged himself, and the whole household died with him in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the army entered Lingqiu; Magistrate Jiang Bingcai raised troops and held firm, but when strength gave out the crowd dispersed; he hanged himself and the whole household perished with him.

sentences.zh: 守備於世奇，把總陳彥武、馬如豸，典史張標，教諭路登甫並鬥死。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander Yu Shiqi, Squad Leaders Chen Yanwu and Ma Ruzhi, Clerk Zhang Biao, and Instructor Lu Dengfu all died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander Yu Shiqi, squad leaders Chen Yanwu and Ma Ruzhi, Clerk Zhang Biao, and Instructor Lu Dengfu all died in battle.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈生斗太僕少卿，余贈恤如制。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Shengdou was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; the others received posthumous grants according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, Shengdou was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; the others received posthumous honors according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 秉采，字衷白，全州舉人。

translations.literal: Bingcai, courtesy name Zhongbai, was a provincial graduate of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bingcai, styled Zhongbai, was a provincial graduate of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 王肇坤，字亦資，蘭溪人。

translations.literal: Wang Zhaokun, courtesy name Yizi, was a native of Lanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhaokun, styled Yizi, was a native of Lanxi.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the civil examinations in the fourth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the civil examinations in the fourth year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 除刑部主事，改御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Justice and was transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Justice and later transferred to censor.

sentences.zh: 初，流賊破鳳陽，疏言兵驕將悍之弊，請假督撫重權，大將犯軍令者，便宜行戳。

translations.literal: Earlier, when bandits took Fengyang, he submitted a memorial on the evils of arrogant soldiers and fierce generals, requesting that governors-general and grand coordinators be granted heavy authority, and that any great general who violated military orders might be executed on the spot at convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when bandits took Fengyang, he memorialized on the evils of arrogant soldiers and fierce generals, asking that governors-general and grand coordinators be given broad authority and that any senior general who violated military orders be executed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 得旨申飭而已。

translations.literal: He received an edict of admonition and nothing more.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued an edict of admonition and nothing more.

sentences.zh: 出巡山海、居庸二關。

translations.literal: He went out on inspection tour of the Shanhai and Juyong Passes.
translations.idiomatic: He went on inspection tour of the Shanhai and Juyong Passes.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，大清兵入喜峰口，肇坤激眾往禦，不敵，退保昌平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Great Qing troops entered Xifeng Pass; Zhaokun roused the people to meet them, could not withstand them, and withdrew to defend Changping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Great Qing troops entered Xifeng Pass; Zhaokun roused the people to meet them but could not hold and withdrew to defend Changping.

sentences.zh: 被圍，與守陵太監王希忠，總兵官巢丕昌，戶部主事王一桂、趙悅，攝知州事保定通判王禹佐分門守。

translations.literal: When besieged, together with Tomb-Guarding Eunuch Wang Xizhong, Commander-in-Chief Chao Pichang, Ministry of Revenue Clerks Wang Yigui and Zhao Yue, and Baoding Assistant Prefect Wang Yuzuo, acting magistrate, he defended the gates separately.
translations.idiomatic: When besieged, he joined the tomb-guarding eunuch Wang Xizhong, Commander-in-Chief Chao Pichang, Ministry of Revenue clerks Wang Yigui and Zhao Yue, and Baoding Assistant Prefect Wang Yuzuo, acting magistrate, in defending the gates separately.

sentences.zh: 有降丁二千為內應，城遂破，肇坤被四矢兩刃而死。

translations.literal: Two thousand surrendered troops served as inside collaborators, and the city was then taken; Zhaokun was struck by four arrows and two blades and died.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand surrendered troops served as inside collaborators, and the city fell; Zhaokun was struck by four arrows and two blades and died.

sentences.zh: 丕昌出降。

translations.literal: Pichang came out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Pichang came out and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 一桂、悅、禹佐、希忠及判官胡惟忠、吏目郭永、學正解懷亮、訓導常時光、守備咸貞吉皆死之。

translations.literal: Yigui, Yue, Yuzuo, Xizhong, Assistant Magistrate Hu Weizhong, Clerk Guo Yong, Director of Studies Xie Huailiang, Instructor Chang Shiguang, and Garrison Commander Xian Zhenji all died.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui, Yue, Yuzuo, Xizhong, Assistant Magistrate Hu Weizhong, Clerk Guo Yong, Director of Studies Xie Huailiang, Instructor Chang Shiguang, and Garrison Commander Xian Zhenji all perished.

sentences.zh: 禹佐子亦從父死。

translations.literal: Yuzuo's son also followed his father to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzuo's son also died with his father.

sentences.zh: 一桂，黃岡舉人，督餉昌平，以南城最沖，身往扼之。

translations.literal: Yigui, a provincial graduate of Huanggang, supervised grain transport at Changping; because the south gate was the most exposed, he went in person to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui, a provincial graduate of Huanggang, supervised grain transport at Changping; because the south gate was the most exposed, he went in person to hold it.

sentences.zh: 俄西城失守，被執死。

translations.literal: Before long the west gate fell; he was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the west gate fell; he was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 妻妾子女暨家眾二十七人悉赴井死。

translations.literal: His wives, concubines, sons, daughters, and the entire household—twenty-seven people in all—all threw themselves into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: His wives, concubines, children, and the entire household—twenty-seven people in all—all threw themselves into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 悅以公事赴昌平，遂遇難。

translations.literal: Yue had gone to Changping on official business and thus met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Yue had gone to Changping on official business and thus met his end.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大清兵攻順義。

translations.literal: Before long Great Qing troops attacked Shunyi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Great Qing troops attacked Shunyi.

sentences.zh: 知縣上官藎，字忠赤，曲沃人。

translations.literal: Magistrate Shangguan Jin, courtesy name Zhongchi, was a native of Quwo.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Shangguan Jin, styled Zhongchi, was a native of Quwo.

sentences.zh: 起家鄉舉，廉執有聲，在官三年，薦章十餘上。

translations.literal: He rose from the provincial examinations; his integrity and strictness won renown; in three years in office more than ten recommendation memorials went up on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the provincial examinations; his integrity and strictness won renown; in three years in office more than ten recommendation memorials were submitted on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 與遊擊治國器、都指揮蘇時雨等拒守。

translations.literal: Together with Guerrilla Commander Zhi Guoqi, Commander Su Shiyu, and others he held the defense.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Guerrilla Commander Zhi Guoqi, Commander Su Shiyu, and others he held the defense.

sentences.zh: 城破，藎自經。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Jin hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Jin hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 國器、時雨及訓導陳所蘊皆死。

translations.literal: Guoqi, Shiyu, and Instructor Chen Suoyun all died.
translations.idiomatic: Guoqi, Shiyu, and Instructor Chen Suoyun all perished.

sentences.zh: 尋破寶坻，知縣趙國鼎、主簿樊樞、典史張六師、訓導趙士秀皆死。

translations.literal: Soon after Baodi fell; Magistrate Zhao Guoding, Registrar Fan Shu, Clerk Zhang Liushi, and Instructor Zhao Shixiu all died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after Baodi fell; Magistrate Zhao Guoding, Registrar Fan Shu, Clerk Zhang Liushi, and Instructor Zhao Shixiu all died.

sentences.zh: 國鼎，山西樂平人。

translations.literal: Guoding was a native of Leping in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guoding was a native of Leping in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 鄉試第一，崇禎七年進士。

translations.literal: He ranked first in the provincial examinations and passed the civil examinations in the seventh year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He ranked first in the provincial examinations and passed the civil examinations in the seventh year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 破定興，教諭灤州熊嘉誌殉節死。

translations.literal: When Dingxing fell, Instructor Xiong Jiazhi of Luanzhou died in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingxing fell, Instructor Xiong Jiazhi of Luanzhou died in martyrdom.

sentences.zh: 破安肅，知縣臨清鄭延任與妻同殉。

translations.literal: When Ansu fell, Magistrate Zheng Yanren of Linqing died in martyrdom together with his wife.
translations.idiomatic: When Ansu fell, Magistrate Zheng Yanren of Linqing died in martyrdom together with his wife.

sentences.zh: 教諭靈壽耿三麟亦死之。

translations.literal: Instructor Geng Sanlin of Lingshou also died.
translations.idiomatic: Instructor Geng Sanlin of Lingshou also died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈肇坤大理卿，予祭葬，官一子。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Zhaokun was posthumously granted Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, given sacrificial rites and burial, and one son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, Zhaokun was posthumously granted Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, given sacrificial rites and burial, and one son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 一桂、悅並贈太僕少卿，蔭子祭葬，余贈恤如制。

translations.literal: Yigui and Yue were both posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; sons were granted hereditary office, sacrificial rites, and burial; the rest received posthumous grants according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui and Yue were both posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; sons were granted hereditary office, sacrificial rites, and burial; the rest received posthumous honors according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 孫士美，青浦人。

translations.literal: Sun Shimei was a native of Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shimei was a native of Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉授舒城教諭。

translations.literal: Through the provincial examinations he was appointed instructor at Shucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Through the provincial examinations he was appointed instructor at Shucheng.

sentences.zh: 崇禎八年春，賊來犯，縣令以公事出，士美代守七十餘日，城以全。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year of Chongzhen, when bandits came to attack, the magistrate was away on official business; Shimei held the defense in his stead for more than seventy days, and the city was preserved intact.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year of Chongzhen, when bandits came to attack, the magistrate was away on official business; Shimei held the defense in his stead for more than seventy days, and the city was preserved.

sentences.zh: 明年擢知深州。

translations.literal: The following year he was promoted to magistrate of Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to magistrate of Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，大清兵至，力守三日，城破，自剄於角樓。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eleventh year, Great Qing troops arrived; he defended resolutely for three days; when the city fell he cut his throat in the corner tower.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eleventh year, Great Qing troops arrived; he defended resolutely for three days; when the city fell he cut his throat in the corner tower.

sentences.zh: 父訥亦自縊，一家死者十三人。

translations.literal: His father Ne also hanged himself; thirteen in the household died.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ne also hanged himself; thirteen members of the household died.

sentences.zh: 贈太僕少卿，訥亦被旌。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud, and Ne was also granted an honorary commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud, and Ne was also granted an honorary commendation.

sentences.zh: 是時，畿輔諸郡悉被兵，長吏多望風遁，失城四十有八。

translations.literal: At this time all commanderies of the capital region alike suffered warfare; many chief officials fled at the mere report of danger, and forty-eight cities were lost.
translations.idiomatic: At this time every commandery in the capital region suffered warfare; many chief officials fled at the mere rumor of attack, and forty-eight cities were lost.

sentences.zh: 任丘白慧元、慶都黃承宗、靈壽馮登鰲、文安王鑰、蠡縣王采、新河崔賢、鹽山陳誌、故城王九鼎，皆以殉難聞。

translations.literal: Bai Huiyuan of Renqiu, Huang Chengzong of Qingdu, Feng Deng'ao of Lingshou, Wang Yao of Wen'an, Wang Cai of Lixian, Cui Xian of Xinhe, Chen Zhi of Yanshan, and Wang Jiuding of Gucheng all became famed for dying in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Huiyuan of Renqiu, Huang Chengzong of Qingdu, Feng Deng'ao of Lingshou, Wang Yao of Wen'an, Wang Cai of Lixian, Cui Xian of Xinhe, Chen Zhi of Yanshan, and Wang Jiuding of Gucheng all became famed for dying in martyrdom.

sentences.zh: 他若青縣張文煥、興濟錢珍、慶雲陳緘，城破被殺。

translations.literal: Others such as Zhang Wenhuan of Qingxian, Qian Zhen of Xingji, and Chen Jian of Qingyun were killed when their cities fell.
translations.idiomatic: Others such as Zhang Wenhuan of Qingxian, Qian Zhen of Xingji, and Chen Jian of Qingyun were killed when their cities fell.

sentences.zh: 教官死難者則有劉廷訓、張純儒、唐一中。

translations.literal: Among instructors who died in martyrdom were Liu Tingxun, Zhang Chunru, and Tang Yizhong.
translations.idiomatic: Among instructors who died in martyrdom were Liu Tingxun, Zhang Chunru, and Tang Yizhong.

sentences.zh: 鄉官則喬若雯、李禎寧最著。

translations.literal: Among local gentry the most notable were Qiao Ruowen and Li Zhenning.
translations.idiomatic: Among local gentry the most notable were Qiao Ruowen and Li Zhenning.

sentences.zh: 而棄城者，吳橋知縣李綦隆等十人，皆坐死。

translations.literal: Those who abandoned their cities—Wuqiao Magistrate Li Qilong and nine others—all were punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: Those who abandoned their cities—Wuqiao Magistrate Li Qilong and nine others—were all punished with death.

sentences.zh: 白慧元，青澗人。

translations.literal: Bai Huiyuan was a native of Qingjian.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Huiyuan was a native of Qingjian.

sentences.zh: 崇禎七年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the civil examinations in the seventh year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the civil examinations in the seventh year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 居官善祛蠹，吏民畏之。

translations.literal: In office he was skilled at removing corruption, and officials and people feared him.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was skilled at rooting out corruption, and officials and people feared him.

sentences.zh: 九年以守城功，命減俸行取。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for merit in defending the city, he was ordered to have his salary reduced while being selected for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, for merit in defending the city, he was ordered to have his salary reduced while being selected for promotion.

sentences.zh: 會與大閹有隙，摭其罪於帝，逮治之，未行，大兵已抵城下，乃與代者李廉仲共守。

translations.literal: It happened that he had a quarrel with a great eunuch, who collected accusations against him and reported them to the Emperor; he was arrested for investigation, but before the order could be carried out the great army had already reached the city walls, and so he defended jointly with his successor Li Lianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that he had a quarrel with a powerful eunuch, who collected accusations against him and reported them to the emperor; he was arrested for investigation, but before the order could be carried out the great army had already reached the walls, and so he defended jointly with his successor Li Lianzhong.

sentences.zh: 無何，廉仲縋城遁，慧元躬擐甲胄，防禦甚力。

translations.literal: Before long Lianzhong lowered himself from the wall by rope and fled; Huiyuan personally donned armor and defended with great vigor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Lianzhong lowered himself from the wall by rope and fled; Huiyuan personally donned armor and defended with great vigor.

sentences.zh: 及城破，一門俱死，贈僉事。

translations.literal: When the city fell the entire household perished; he was posthumously granted Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell the entire household perished; he was posthumously granted Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鄉官李禎寧，萬曆三十八年進士。

translations.literal: Local gentry Li Zhenning passed the civil examinations in the thirty-eighth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: Local gentry Li Zhenning passed the civil examinations in the thirty-eighth year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 歷山西按察使，罷歸，佐慧元拒守。

translations.literal: He served as Shanxi Surveillance Commissioner, then retired after dismissal and assisted Huiyuan in holding the defense.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Shanxi Surveillance Commissioner, then retired after dismissal and assisted Huiyuan in holding the defense.

sentences.zh: 城破，率家眾格鬥，身中數槊而死，一門從死者數人。

translations.literal: When the city fell he led his household in hand-to-hand fighting; he was struck by several spears and died; several in the household followed him to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he led his household in hand-to-hand fighting; he was struck by several spears and died, and several in the household followed him to death.

sentences.zh: 承宗，未詳何許人。

translations.literal: Chengzong—it is not clear from which place he came.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong—it is not clear where he came from.

sentences.zh: 馮登鰲，膚施舉人，其從父大緯為蠡縣訓導，亦死。

translations.literal: Feng Deng'ao was a provincial graduate of Fushi; his father's younger brother Dawei served as instructor at Lixian and also died.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Deng'ao was a provincial graduate of Fushi; his uncle Dawei served as instructor at Lixian and also died.

sentences.zh: 王鑰，武功舉人。

translations.literal: Wang Yao was a provincial graduate of Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yao was a provincial graduate of Wugong.

sentences.zh: 王采，澤州人，進士。

translations.literal: Wang Cai was a native of Zezhou and a metropolitan graduate.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cai was a native of Zezhou and a metropolitan graduate.

sentences.zh: 崔賢，弋州舉人。

translations.literal: Cui Xian was a provincial graduate of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xian was a provincial graduate of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 誌、九鼎，亦未詳何許人，誌自經死，九鼎戰死城上，各贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Zhi and Jiuding—it is also not clear from which places they came; Zhi hanged himself, Jiuding died fighting on the wall; each received posthumous grants of differing rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi and Jiuding—it is also not clear where they came from; Zhi hanged himself and Jiuding died fighting on the wall; each received posthumous honors of differing rank.

sentences.zh: 劉廷訓，順天通州人。

translations.literal: Liu Tingxun was a native of Tongzhou in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tingxun was a native of Tongzhou in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 歲貢生，為吳橋訓導。

translations.literal: A tribute student, he served as instructor at Wuqiao.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute student, he served as instructor at Wuqiao.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十一年，大清兵入畿內，知縣李綦隆欲遁，廷訓止之，與共守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen, when Great Qing troops entered the capital region, Magistrate Li Qilong wished to flee; Tingxun stopped him and defended together.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen, when Great Qing troops entered the capital region, Magistrate Li Qilong wished to flee; Tingxun stopped him and defended together.

sentences.zh: 外圍將合，綦隆縋城走。

translations.literal: As the outer encirclement was about to close, Qilong lowered himself from the wall by rope and fled.
translations.idiomatic: As the outer encirclement was about to close, Qilong lowered himself from the wall by rope and fled.

sentences.zh: 廷訓急趨城上，語守者曰：「守死，逃亦死，盍死於守，為忠義鬼乎！

translations.literal: Tingxun rushed to the wall and said to the defenders: "To die defending is death; to flee is also death—why not die defending and become a ghost of loyalty and righteousness?"
translations.idiomatic: Tingxun rushed to the wall and said to the defenders: "To die defending is death; to flee is also death—why not die defending and become a ghost of loyalty and righteousness?"

sentences.zh: 」眾泣諾，乃堅拒三晝夜。

translations.literal: The crowd wept and assented; they held firm in resistance for three days and three nights.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd wept and assented; they held firm in resistance for three days and three nights.

sentences.zh: 廷訓中流矢，束胸力戰，又中六矢乃死。

translations.literal: Tingxun was struck by an arrow; he bound his chest and fought with force, and after being struck by six more arrows he died.
translations.idiomatic: Tingxun was struck by an arrow; he bound his chest and fought on, and after being struck by six more arrows he died.

sentences.zh: 逾月，其子啟棺更殮，面如生。

translations.literal: A month later his son opened the coffin to re-enclose the body, and the face looked as if alive.
translations.idiomatic: A month later his son opened the coffin to re-enclose the body, and the face looked as if he were still alive.

sentences.zh: 張純儒，新安人，為臨城訓導，率諸生共城守，城破死之。

translations.literal: Zhang Chunru, a native of Xin'an, served as instructor at Lincheng; he led the students jointly in defending the city and died when it fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chunru, a native of Xin'an, served as instructor at Lincheng; he led the students in defending the city and died when it fell.

sentences.zh: 唐一中，全州人，為鉅鹿教諭，抗節死。

translations.literal: Tang Yizhong, a native of Quanzhou, served as instructor at Julu and died resisting to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yizhong, a native of Quanzhou, served as instructor at Julu and died resisting to the end.

sentences.zh: 時鄉官李崇德、董祚、魏克家並以城亡殉難。

translations.literal: At the time the local gentry Li Chongde, Dong Zuo, and Wei Kejia all died in martyrdom when their cities were lost.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the local gentry Li Chongde, Dong Zuo, and Wei Kejia all died in martyrdom when their cities were lost.

sentences.zh: 崇德，青縣人。

translations.literal: Chongde was a native of Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: Chongde was a native of Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 祚，隆平人。

translations.literal: Zuo was a native of Longping.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo was a native of Longping.

sentences.zh: 克家，高陽人。

translations.literal: Kejia was a native of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Kejia was a native of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 皆舉人。

translations.literal: All were provincial graduates.
translations.idiomatic: All three were provincial graduates.

sentences.zh: 崇德歷戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: Chongde had served as Assistant Department Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Chongde had served as Assistant Department Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 祚未仕。

translations.literal: Zuo had never taken office.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo had never held office.

sentences.zh: 克家為鄒平知縣，有善政。

translations.literal: Kejia served as magistrate of Zouping and had good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Kejia served as magistrate of Zouping and governed with notable benevolence.

sentences.zh: 若雯贈太常少卿，余贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Ruowen was posthumously awarded Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the rest received posthumous honors of varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Ruowen was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the others received posthumous honors in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 張秉文，字含之，桐城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Bingwen, styled Hanzhi, was a native of Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bingwen, styled Hanzhi, was a native of Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 祖淳，官參政，事具《循吏傳》。

translations.literal: His grandfather Chun had held the office of Administrator; his career is fully recorded in the Biography of Upright Officials.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Chun had served as Administrator; his career is recorded in full in the Biography of Upright Officials.

sentences.zh: 秉文舉萬曆三十八年進士，歷福建右參政，與平海寇李魁奇。

translations.literal: Bingwen passed the jinshi examination in Wanli 38, served successively as Right Assistant Administration Commissioner of Fujian, and helped suppress the sea bandit Li Kuiqi.
translations.idiomatic: Bingwen passed the jinshi examination in Wanli 38, served as Right Assistant Administration Commissioner of Fujian, and took part in suppressing the sea bandit Li Kuiqi.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，歷廣東按察使，右布政使，調山東為左。

translations.literal: During the Chongzhen reign he served successively as Surveillance Commissioner of Guangdong and Right Administration Commissioner, and was transferred to Shandong as Left Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he served successively as Surveillance Commissioner of Guangdong and Right Administration Commissioner, then was transferred to Shandong as Left Administration Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，大清兵自畿輔南下。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eleventh year, Qing forces marched south from the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eleventh year, Qing forces marched south from the capital region.

sentences.zh: 本兵楊嗣昌檄山東巡撫顏繼祖移師德州，於是濟南空虛，止鄉兵五百，萊州援兵七百，勢弱不足守。

translations.literal: Minister of War Yang Sichang ordered Shandong Grand Coordinator Yan Jizu to move his army to Dezhou; thus Jinan was left empty, with only five hundred local militia and seven hundred relief troops from Laizhou — too few and too weak to defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Yang Sichang ordered Shandong Grand Coordinator Yan Jizu to shift his forces to Dezhou. Jinan was left virtually undefended, with only five hundred local militia and seven hundred relief troops from Laizhou — far too few to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史宋學朱方行部章丘，聞警馳還，與秉文及副使周之訓、翁鴻業，參議鄧謙，鹽運使唐世熊等議守城，連章告急於朝。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Song Xuezhu was on inspection in Zhangqiu; hearing the alarm he galloped back. Together with Bingwen, Vice Commissioner Zhou Zhixun and Weng Hongye, Consultant Deng Qian, Salt Transport Commissioner Tang Shixiong, and others, he deliberated on defending the city and repeatedly memorialized the court in urgent reports.
translations.idiomatic: Touring Censor Song Xuezhu was on inspection in Zhangqiu when he heard the alarm and raced back. He joined Bingwen, Vice Commissioners Zhou Zhixun and Weng Hongye, Consultant Deng Qian, Salt Transport Commissioner Tang Shixiong, and others to plan the city's defense, sending one urgent memorial after another to the court.

sentences.zh: 嗣昌無以應，督師中官高起潛擁重兵臨清不救，大將祖寬、倪寵等亦觀望。

translations.literal: Sichang had no response. Supervising eunuch general Gao Qiqian held a large army at Linqing but would not rescue them; great generals Zu Kuan, Ni Chong, and others also held back and watched.
translations.idiomatic: Sichang offered no answer. Supervising eunuch general Gao Qiqian sat at Linqing with a large army and refused to intervene, while great generals Zu Kuan, Ni Chong, and others likewise held back and watched.

sentences.zh: 大清兵徇下州縣十有六，遂臨濟南。

translations.literal: Qing forces swept through sixteen subordinate prefectures and counties, then approached Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Qing forces overran sixteen subordinate prefectures and counties before arriving at Jinan.

sentences.zh: 秉文等分門死守，晝夜不解甲，援兵竟無至者。

translations.literal: Bingwen and the others defended each gate to the death, going day and night without removing their armor, yet relief troops never arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Bingwen and his colleagues held each gate to the death, keeping their armor on day and night, but no relief force ever came.

sentences.zh: 明年正月二日，城潰，秉文擐甲巷戰，已被箭，力不能支，死之。

translations.literal: On the second day of the first month of the following year the walls were breached. Bingwen, clad in armor, fought in the lanes; already wounded by arrows, he could no longer hold out and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the first month of the following year the walls gave way. Clad in armor, Bingwen fought street by street; already pierced by arrows, he could no longer hold out and was killed.

sentences.zh: 妻方、妾陳，並投大明湖死。

translations.literal: His wife Fang and concubine Chen both threw themselves into Daming Lake and died.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Fang and concubine Chen both drowned themselves in Daming Lake.

sentences.zh: 學朱、之訓、謙、世熊及濟南知府茍好善、同知陳虞胤、通判熊烈獻、歷城知縣韓承宣皆死焉，德王由樞被執。

translations.literal: Xuezhu, Zhixun, Qian, Shixiong, Jinan Prefect Gou Haoshan, Vice Prefect Chen Yuyin, Assistant Prefect Xiong Liexian, and Licheng County Magistrate Han Chengxuan all died; Prince De Zhu Youshu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Xuezhu, Zhixun, Qian, Shixiong, Jinan Prefect Gou Haoshan, Vice Prefect Chen Yuyin, Assistant Prefect Xiong Liexian, and Licheng County Magistrate Han Chengxuan all perished, and Prince De Zhu Youshu was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 秉文贈太常寺卿，之訓、謙光祿卿，承宣光祿少卿，皆建特祠，餘贈恤如制。

translations.literal: Bingwen was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Zhixun and Qian were made Ministers of Imperial Entertainments; Chengxuan was made Vice Minister of Imperial Entertainments; special shrines were built for all of them, and the others received posthumous honors according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Bingwen was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Zhixun and Qian were made Ministers of Imperial Entertainments; Chengxuan was made Vice Minister of Imperial Entertainments. Special shrines were erected for them, and the others received posthumous honors as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 學朱死，不得屍，疑未實，獨格不予，福王時，贈大理卿。

translations.literal: When Xuezhu died his body could not be recovered, so it was suspected the report was unverified and he alone was denied posthumous honors; under the Prince of Fu he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xuezhu's body could not be recovered after his death, the court doubted the report and alone withheld posthumous honors from him; under the Prince of Fu he was at last posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 鴻業及推官陸燦不知所終，贈恤亦不及。

translations.literal: Hongye and Assistant Magistrate Lu Can vanished without trace, and received no posthumous honors either.
translations.idiomatic: Hongye and Assistant Magistrate Lu Can disappeared without a trace and received no posthumous honors at all.

sentences.zh: 學朱，字用晦，長洲人。

translations.literal: Xuezhu, styled Yonghui, was a native of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xuezhu, styled Yonghui, was a native of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 4.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 4.

sentences.zh: 為御史，嘗抗疏劾楊嗣昌、田維嘉，時論壯之。

translations.literal: As a censor he had once submitted forceful memorials impeaching Yang Sichang and Tian Weijia, which contemporaries applauded.
translations.idiomatic: As a censor he had once submitted bold memorials impeaching Yang Sichang and Tian Weijia, which won wide praise at the time.

sentences.zh: 之訓，黃岡人，進士。

translations.literal: Zhixun was a native of Huanggang and a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixun was a native of Huanggang and a jinshi graduate.

sentences.zh: 累官浙江按察使，坐事貶官，被薦未擢而遘難。

translations.literal: He had risen to Surveillance Commissioner of Zhejiang, was demoted for an offense, was recommended for promotion but had not yet been appointed when calamity struck.
translations.idiomatic: He had risen to Surveillance Commissioner of Zhejiang, was demoted for an offense, and had been recommended for promotion but not yet appointed when calamity overtook him.

sentences.zh: 望闕再拜，與妻劉偕死，闔門殉之。

translations.literal: He bowed twice toward the palace and died together with his wife Liu; the whole household perished with them.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed twice toward the palace, then died together with his wife Liu; the entire household perished with them.

sentences.zh: 謙，孝感人，進士。

translations.literal: Qian was a native of Xiaogan and a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Qian was a native of Xiaogan and a jinshi graduate.

sentences.zh: 戰於城上，與季父有正偕死，母莫氏匿民間不食死，族戚傔從，死者四十餘人。

translations.literal: Fighting atop the wall, he died together with his uncle Youzheng; his mother Lady Mo hid among the people and starved herself to death; among clansmen, retainers, and attendants, more than forty died.
translations.idiomatic: He fought atop the wall and died together with his uncle Youzheng. His mother Lady Mo hid among the common people and starved herself to death. Among kinsmen, retainers, and attendants, more than forty perished.

sentences.zh: 世熊，灌陽舉人，分守西門，被殺。

translations.literal: Shixiong was a provincial graduate from Guanyang; assigned to guard the west gate, he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Shixiong was a provincial graduate from Guanyang who was assigned to hold the west gate and was killed there.

sentences.zh: 好善，醴泉人，進士。

translations.literal: Haoshan was a native of Liquan and a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Haoshan was a native of Liquan and a jinshi graduate.

sentences.zh: 虞胤，未詳。

translations.literal: Yuyin's details are unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Yuyin's background is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 烈獻，黃陂貢生，城破，與二子俱死。

translations.literal: Liexian was a tribute student from Huangpi; when the city fell he died together with his two sons.
translations.idiomatic: Liexian was a tribute student from Huangpi; when the city fell he died together with his two sons.

sentences.zh: 承宜，大學士爌孫，進士，與妻妾同死。

translations.literal: Chengxuan was the grandson of Grand Secretary Han; a jinshi, he died together with his wife and concubines.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxuan was the grandson of Grand Secretary Han; a jinshi, he died together with his wife and concubines.

sentences.zh: 有劉大年者，江西廣昌人。

translations.literal: There was one Liu Danian, a native of Guangchang in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Liu Danian, a native of Guangchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 官兵部主事，奉使南京，還朝，道歷城，城破抗節死。

translations.literal: He had been a Director in the Ministry of War; on a mission to Nanjing, he was returning to court when, passing through Licheng, the city fell and he died resisting to the end.
translations.idiomatic: He had served as a Director in the Ministry of War. Sent on a mission to Nanjing, he was returning to court when he passed through Licheng; the city fell, and he died upholding his integrity to the end.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿少卿。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Minister of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Minister of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 時大清兵所破州縣，守令失城者，皆論死。

translations.literal: At that time in prefectures and counties broken by Qing forces, magistrates and prefects who lost their cities were all sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, in every prefecture and county overrun by Qing forces, the magistrates and prefects who lost their cities were all sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 而臨邑宋希堯、博平張列宿、茌平黃建極、武城李承芳、丘縣高重光，皆以死節蒙贈恤。

translations.literal: Yet Song Xiyao of Linyi, Zhang Liesu of Boping, Huang Jianji of Chiping, Li Chengfang of Wucheng, and Gao Chongguang of Qiu County all died in loyal sacrifice and received posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Song Xiyao of Linyi, Zhang Liesu of Boping, Huang Jianji of Chiping, Li Chengfang of Wucheng, and Gao Chongguang of Qiu County all died holding their posts and received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 重光，字秀恒，保定人。

translations.literal: Chongguang, styled Xiuheng, was a native of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Chongguang, styled Xiuheng, was a native of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 由貢生為柏鄉訓導，率蒼頭擊盜以全城，遂擢為令。

translations.literal: From tribute student he became Director of Studies at Baijiang; leading household servants he drove off bandits and preserved the whole county, and was therefore promoted to magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a tribute student, he became Director of Studies at Baijiang; leading his household servants he drove off bandits and saved the entire county, and was therefore promoted to magistrate.

sentences.zh: 及大軍至，吏民欲負之逃，重光不可，抱印赴井死。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, officials and people wanted to carry him away to flee, but Chongguang would not allow it; embracing the official seal he threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the great army arrived, officials and commoners wanted to carry him away to safety, but Chongguang refused; clutching the official seal he threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 其縉紳殉難者，恩縣李應薦，天啟時，官御史。

translations.literal: Among the gentry who died in the calamity, Li Yingjian of En County had been a censor in the Tianqi reign.
translations.idiomatic: Among the gentry who died in the calamity was Li Yingjian of En County, who had served as a censor in the Tianqi reign.

sentences.zh: 以附魏忠賢，麗名逆案。

translations.literal: He had sided with Wei Zhongxian and was listed in the case of factional criminals.
translations.idiomatic: He had sided with Wei Zhongxian and was listed among the factional criminals.

sentences.zh: 至是，捐貲募士，佐有司力守城，城破，身被數刃而死。

translations.literal: At this time he donated funds to recruit men and assisted the local officials in vigorously defending the city; when the city fell he was cut by many blades and died.
translations.idiomatic: Now he donated his own funds to recruit men and helped the local officials defend the city with all their strength; when the city fell he was cut down by many blades and died.

sentences.zh: 歷城劉化光與子漢儀先後舉於鄉，父子俱守城力戰死，贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Liu Huaguang of Licheng and his son Hanyi had both passed the provincial examination at different times; father and son both defended the city, fought hard, and died; posthumous honors were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huaguang of Licheng and his son Hanyi had passed the provincial examination in different years; father and son both defended the city, fought to the end, and died. Posthumous honors were granted in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 顏胤紹，字賡明，曲阜人，復聖六十五代孫也。

translations.literal: Yan Yinshao, styled Gengming, was a native of Qufu and the sixty-fifth-generation descendant of the Restored Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yinshao, styled Gengming, was a native of Qufu and the sixty-fifth-generation descendant of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 4.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 4.

sentences.zh: 歷知鳳陽、江都、邯鄲，遷真定同知，守城剿寇有功。

translations.literal: He served successively as magistrate of Fengyang, Jiangdu, and Handan, was promoted to Vice Prefect of Zhending, and had merit in defending the city and suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as magistrate of Fengyang, Jiangdu, and Handan, was promoted to Vice Prefect of Zhending, and won distinction for defending the city and suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 十五年擢河間知府，比歲大饑，死亡載道，寇盜充斥，拊循甚至。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Prefect of Hejian; famine had struck for successive years, corpses filled the roads, bandits and robbers swarmed everywhere, yet he comforted and cared for the people with the utmost diligence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Prefect of Hejian. Famine had ravaged the region year after year; corpses lined the roads and bandits roamed everywhere, yet he comforted and cared for the people with extraordinary devotion.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月，大清兵至，與參議趙珽、同知姚汝明、知縣陳三接等堅守。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month Qing forces arrived; together with Consultant Zhao Ting, Vice Prefect Yao Ruming, County Magistrate Chen Sanjie, and others he held firm in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month Qing forces arrived. Together with Consultant Zhao Ting, Vice Prefect Yao Ruming, County Magistrate Chen Sanjie, and others, he held the city in staunch defense.

sentences.zh: 援兵雲集，率逗遛。

translations.literal: Relief armies gathered in great numbers but mostly dawdled.
translations.idiomatic: Relief armies gathered in great numbers, but for the most part they dawdled and held back.

sentences.zh: 胤紹知城必破，豫集一家老稚於室中，積薪繞之，而身往城上策戰守。

translations.literal: Yinshao knew the city must fall; beforehand he gathered the old and young of his household in a room, piled firewood around them, and himself went to the wall to direct strategy for battle and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yinshao knew the city was doomed. Beforehand he gathered the old and young of his household in one room and piled firewood around them, then went up to the wall himself to direct the defense.

sentences.zh: 城破，趨歸官舍，舉火焚室，衣冠北向再拜，躍入火中同死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he rushed back to the official residence, set fire and burned the room; dressed in cap and belt he bowed twice toward the north, leapt into the flames, and died together with his family.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he rushed back to the official residence, set the room ablaze, dressed himself in cap and belt, bowed twice toward the north, leapt into the fire, and died together with his family.

sentences.zh: 珽，字秉珪，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Ting, styled Binggui, was a native of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Ting, styled Binggui, was a native of Cixi.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 1.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Chongzhen 1.

sentences.zh: 知南安、侯官二縣，屢遷河間兵備僉事，一門十四人悉被難。

translations.literal: He had been magistrate of Nan'an and Houguan counties; promoted repeatedly to Hejian Military Defense Vice Commissioner; fourteen members of his household all perished in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He had served as magistrate of Nan'an and Houguan counties and was promoted repeatedly to Hejian Military Defense Vice Commissioner; fourteen members of his household all perished in the calamity.

sentences.zh: 汝明，夏縣人。

translations.literal: Ruming was a native of Xia County.
translations.idiomatic: Ruming was a native of Xia County.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 性孝友。

translations.literal: By nature he was filial and brotherly.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was filial and devoted to his brothers.

sentences.zh: 崇禎間歲大祲，傾廩振濟，立義冢，瘞暴骨。

translations.literal: During the Chongzhen years, when famine struck year after year, he emptied the granaries to provide relief, established a public burial ground, and interred exposed bones.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen years, when famine struck year after year, he emptied the granaries to provide relief, established a public burial ground, and interred the bones of the unburied dead.

sentences.zh: 授蠡縣知縣，聞鄉邑又饑，貽書其子，令振救如初。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Li County, when he heard his native district was famine-stricken again he wrote to his son ordering relief as before.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Li County, when he heard that his native district was stricken by famine again he wrote to his son ordering relief on the same scale as before.

sentences.zh: 後官河間，與妾任同死。

translations.literal: Later serving at Hejian, he died together with his concubine Ren.
translations.idiomatic: Later, while serving at Hejian, he died together with his concubine Ren.

sentences.zh: 三接，文水人。

translations.literal: Sanjie was a native of Wenshui.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjie was a native of Wenshui.

sentences.zh: 舉崇禎六年鄉試，知河間縣。

translations.literal: Having passed the provincial examination in Chongzhen 6, he became magistrate of Hejian County.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the provincial examination in Chongzhen 6, he became magistrate of Hejian County.

sentences.zh: 歲旱饑，人相食。

translations.literal: The year was drought-stricken and famine-ridden; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and famine ravaged the land, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 三接至，雨即降。

translations.literal: As soon as Sanjie arrived, rain fell at once.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as Sanjie arrived, rain fell at once.

sentences.zh: 有疑獄，數年不決，至即決之。

translations.literal: There was a doubtful legal case unresolved for years; as soon as he arrived he settled it.
translations.idiomatic: There was a doubtful legal case that had gone unresolved for years; as soon as he arrived he settled it.

sentences.zh: 妻武氏賢，三接見封疆多故，遣之歸，答曰：「夫死忠，妻死節，分也。

translations.literal: His wife Lady Wu was virtuous. When Sanjie saw the frontier in turmoil he sent her home; she replied: "When the husband dies in loyalty, the wife dies in constancy — that is their allotted part."
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Wu was a woman of virtue. When Sanjie saw the frontier in turmoil he sent her home, but she answered: "When the husband dies in loyalty, the wife dies in constancy — that is their allotted part."

sentences.zh: 」三接巷戰死，武從之。

translations.literal: Sanjie died fighting in the lanes; Lady Wu followed him in death.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjie died fighting in the streets; Lady Wu followed him in death.

sentences.zh: 珽贈太僕卿，胤紹光祿卿，汝明、三接並僉事。

translations.literal: Ting was posthumously made Minister of the Imperial Stud; Yinshao Minister of Imperial Entertainments; Ruming and Sanjie were both made Vice Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Ting was posthumously made Minister of the Imperial Stud; Yinshao was made Minister of Imperial Entertainments; Ruming and Sanjie were both made Vice Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 有周而淳者，掖縣人。

translations.literal: There was Zhou Erchun, a native of Ye County.
translations.idiomatic: There was Zhou Erchun, a native of Ye County.

sentences.zh: 由進士拜兵科給事中，與同官六人分督畿輔諸郡城守事。

translations.literal: Having passed the jinshi examination he was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs; together with six fellow censors he divided supervision of city-defense affairs in the various prefectures of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the jinshi examination he was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs; together with six fellow censors he divided oversight of city-defense affairs among the prefectures of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 而淳甫至河間，城即被圍，遂與諸臣同死，贈太常少卿。

translations.literal: Erchun had only just reached Hejian when the city was immediately besieged; he then died together with the other officials and was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Erchun had only just reached Hejian when the city was immediately besieged; he then died together with the other officials and was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 先是，大兵入霸州，兵備副使趙輝偕知州丁師羲、裏居參政李時茪等督士民固拒。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the great army entered Bazhou, Military Defense Vice Commissioner Zhao Hui together with Prefect Ding Shixi, retired-at-home Administrator Li Shimang, and others directed soldiers and people in staunch resistance.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the great army entered Bazhou, Military Defense Vice Commissioner Zhao Hui together with Prefect Ding Shixi, retired-at-home Administrator Li Shimang, and others rallied soldiers and civilians in staunch resistance.

sentences.zh: 援軍不至，城遂破。

translations.literal: Relief troops did not arrive, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Relief troops never came, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 輝整冠帶自盡，子琬同死。

translations.literal: Hui straightened his cap and belt and killed himself; his son Wan died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Hui straightened his cap and belt and took his own life; his son Wan died with him.

sentences.zh: 師羲、時茪皆死之。

translations.literal: Shixi and Shimang both died.
translations.idiomatic: Shixi and Shimang both died as well.

sentences.zh: 輝，字黃如，河津人，崇禎七年進士，贈光祿卿。

translations.literal: Hui, styled Huangru, was a native of Hejin and passed the jinshi in Chongzhen 7; he was posthumously made Minister of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Hui, styled Huangru, was a native of Hejin and a jinshi of Chongzhen 7; he was posthumously made Minister of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 師羲，字象先，楚雄人。

translations.literal: Shixi, styled Xiangxian, was a native of Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Shixi, styled Xiangxian, was a native of Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 選貢生，贈參議。

translations.literal: A selected tribute student, he was posthumously made Consultant.
translations.idiomatic: A selected tribute student, he was posthumously made Consultant.

sentences.zh: 時茪，進士，累官參政，贈太常卿。

translations.literal: Shimang was a jinshi who had risen to Administrator; he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Shimang was a jinshi who had risen to Administrator; he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 吉孔嘉，洋縣人。

translations.literal: Ji Kongjia was a native of Yang County.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Kongjia was a native of Yang County.

sentences.zh: 幼時訴父冤於巡按御史，獲釋，以孝稱。

translations.literal: As a child he pleaded his father's wrongful conviction before the touring censor and secured his release; he was famed for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he pleaded his father's wrongful conviction before the touring censor and secured his release; he was renowned for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 舉崇禎三年鄉試。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination in Chongzhen 3.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in Chongzhen 3.

sentences.zh: 授寧津知縣，蠲繁苛，除寇賊，闔邑頌德。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Ningjin, he removed onerous levies, eliminated bandits and robbers, and the whole county praised his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Ningjin, he lifted onerous levies, cleared out bandits and robbers, and won the praise of the entire county.

sentences.zh: 累遷順德知府。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Prefect of Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly until he became Prefect of Shunde.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，大清兵臨城，與鄉官知府傅梅，中書舍人孟魯缽、張鳳鳴募兵，悉力拒守，力屈城破，孔嘉與妻張、長子惠迪、次子婦王俱死。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year Qing forces approached the city; together with local gentry and Prefect Fu Mei, Secretariat Drafter Meng Lubo, and Zhang Fengming, he recruited troops and resisted with all their strength; when strength was exhausted the city fell. Kongjia died together with his wife Zhang, eldest son Huidi, and second son's wife Wang.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifteenth year Qing forces approached the city. Together with local gentry, Prefect Fu Mei, Secretariat Drafters Meng Lubo and Zhang Fengming, he recruited troops and resisted with all their strength; when their strength was spent the city fell. Kongjia died together with his wife Zhang, his eldest son Huidi, and his second son's wife Wang.

sentences.zh: 贈太僕少卿，妻子皆獲旌。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; his wife and children all received commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud; his wife and children were all granted official commendation.

sentences.zh: 梅，刑臺人。

translations.literal: Mei was a native of Xingtai.
translations.idiomatic: Mei was a native of Xingtai.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十九年舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In Wanli 19 he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 19 he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 除知登封，有善政。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Dengfeng, he had good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Dengfeng, he governed with notable benevolence.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部主事，治張差梃擊案，事別見。

translations.literal: Promoted to Director in the Ministry of Justice, he handled the Zhang Cha club-assault case; the affair is recorded elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Director in the Ministry of Justice, he handled the Zhang Cha club-assault case; that affair is recorded elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 死，贈太常少卿。

translations.literal: In death he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: After his death he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 魯缽，工部主事。

translations.literal: Lubo was a Director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Lubo was a Director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 時以守城殉難者，有王端冕，字服先，江陵舉人。

translations.literal: At that time among those who died defending cities, there was Wang Duanmian, styled Fuxian, a provincial graduate of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among those who died defending their cities was Wang Duanmian, styled Fuxian, a provincial graduate of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 知趙州，以廉惠得民。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Zhao Prefecture he won the people through integrity and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Zhao Prefecture he won the people's trust through integrity and kindness.

sentences.zh: 城破，被執死之。

translations.literal: When the city fell he was captured and put to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 教諭陳廣心，元城人，起家乙榜。

translations.literal: Instructor Chen Guangxin, a native of Yuancheng, entered official life through the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Instructor Chen Guangxin, a native of Yuancheng, entered official life through the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 城將破，衣冠危坐，諸子環泣請避，厲聲曰：「吾平生所學何事，豈為兒女戀戀耶！

translations.literal: When the city was about to fall, he sat upright in cap and gown; his sons gathered around weeping and begged him to flee. He said in a stern voice: "What have I studied all my life — would I cling like a fretful woman or child!"
translations.idiomatic: As the city was on the verge of falling, he sat erect in full official dress while his sons wept around him and pleaded that he escape. He cried out: "What have I spent my life learning, if not to die here — am I to cling to life like some frightened woman?"

sentences.zh: 」遂被殺。

translations.literal: " He was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then put to death.

sentences.zh: 訓導王一統，成安人。

translations.literal: Assistant Instructor Wang Yitong was a native of Cheng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Instructor Wang Yitong came from Cheng'an.

sentences.zh: 居家多義行，死節明倫堂。

translations.literal: At home he performed many righteous deeds and died defending his integrity at the Hall of Illuminating Human Relations.
translations.idiomatic: He was known at home for many acts of righteousness and met his death holding the Hall of Illuminating Human Relations.

sentences.zh: 唐鉉，字節玉，睢州人。

translations.literal: Tang Xuan, styled Jieyu, was a native of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xuan, styled Jieyu, came from Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎七年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the seventh year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in Chongzhen 7.

sentences.zh: 歷定州知州，死之。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Dingzhou and died there.
translations.idiomatic: After serving as magistrate of Dingzhou, he died in office.

sentences.zh: 高維岱，昌邑人。

translations.literal: Gao Weidai was a native of Changyi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Weidai came from Changyi.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，知永清縣，視事甫旬余即遇變，一門死之。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination, became magistrate of Yongqing County, and had been in office barely ten days when crisis struck; his whole household perished.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the provincial examination, he was appointed magistrate of Yongqing; scarcely ten days into his tenure disaster struck, and his entire family died.

sentences.zh: 典史李時正、教諭邸養性、鄉官劉維蕙同死。

translations.literal: Assistant Magistrate Li Shizheng, Instructor Di Yangxing, and local gentry official Liu Weihui died together with him.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Magistrate Li Shizheng, Instructor Di Yangxing, and local official Liu Weihui all died alongside him.

sentences.zh: 清豐破，教諭曹一貞、訓導董調元皆死。

translations.literal: When Qingfeng fell, Instructor Cao Yizhen and Assistant Instructor Dong Tiaoyuan both died.
translations.idiomatic: After Qingfeng was taken, Instructor Cao Yizhen and Assistant Instructor Dong Tiaoyuan both perished.

sentences.zh: 鄉官吏部郎中李其紀、黃州推官侶鶴舉、富陽知縣杜鬥愚亦死之。

translations.literal: Local gentry official Li Qiji, a director in the Ministry of Personnel, Huangzhou investigating magistrate Lu Heju, and Fuyang Magistrate Du Doyu also died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiji of the Ministry of Personnel, Huangzhou investigating magistrate Lu Heju, and Fuyang magistrate Du Doyu, all local gentry officials, died as well.

sentences.zh: 而南樂監生鄭獻書、河間襄陽知縣賈太初、永年山東副使申為憲皆抗節死。

translations.literal: Nanle student Zheng Xiashu, Xiangyang Magistrate of Hejian Jia Taichu, and Yongnian native Shandong Vice Commissioner Shen Weixian all died resisting to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Nanle student Zheng Xiashu, Hejian's Xiangyang magistrate Jia Taichu, and Shandong vice commissioner Shen Weixian of Yongnian all held firm and died.

sentences.zh: 鉉贈右參議。

translations.literal: Xuan was posthumously made Right Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xuan was posthumously appointed Right Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 維岱僉事，余贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Weidai was made Vice Commissioner; the others received posthumous honors in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Weidai was posthumously made vice commissioner, and the rest received differing levels of posthumous recognition.

sentences.zh: 邢國璽，長葛人。

translations.literal: Xing Guoxi was a native of Changge.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Guoxi came from Changge.

sentences.zh: 崇禎七年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the seventh year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in Chongzhen 7.

sentences.zh: 授濰縣知縣，改建石城，盡心民事。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Wei County, rebuilt the stone city walls, and devoted himself wholeheartedly to the people's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Wei County, he rebuilt the stone fortifications and gave himself entirely to local administration.

sentences.zh: 時帝以修城郭、練民兵、儲糗糧、備戎器四事課天下，有司率視為具文，惟國璽奉行如詔。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor assessed the empire on four tasks — repairing walls, training militia, storing provisions, and preparing weapons — and officials generally treated them as empty formality; only Guoxi carried them out as ordered.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had made the whole empire answer for four duties: repairing fortifications, drilling militia, stockpiling grain, and readying arms. Most officials treated the orders as mere paperwork; Guoxi alone implemented them in earnest.

sentences.zh: 上官交薦，遷戶部主事。

translations.literal: Superiors repeatedly recommended him, and he was transferred to be a principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly recommended by his superiors, he was promoted to principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 運道梗於盜，有議開膠萊河者，國璽力陳其便。

translations.literal: The transport route was blocked by bandits; when opening the Jiao-Lai Canal was proposed, Guoxi forcefully argued its advantages.
translations.idiomatic: With the transport route choked by bandits, some proposed reopening the Jiao-Lai Canal, and Guoxi vigorously argued the plan's merits.

sentences.zh: 擢登萊兵備劍事，經度河道。

translations.literal: He was promoted to military preparedness commissioner for Dengzhou and Laizhou and surveyed the canal route.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to military preparedness commissioner for Deng and Lai, he took charge of planning the waterway.

sentences.zh: 十五年，畿輔戒嚴，部檄徵山東兵入衛。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the metropolitan region was placed on alert, and the ministry issued orders summoning Shandong troops to defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 15 the capital district went on high alert, and the ministry ordered Shandong troops called up for its defense.

sentences.zh: 國璽監督至龍岡，猝遇大清兵。

translations.literal: Guoxi, supervising the march, reached Longgang and suddenly encountered the Great Qing army.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxi was escorting the troops as far as Longgang when they suddenly ran into the Qing army.

sentences.zh: 部卒驚懼欲竄，國璽叱止之，身先搏戰，矢刃交加，墮馬死。

translations.literal: The ministry troops panicked and wanted to flee; Guoxi shouted them down, led the charge himself, arrows and blades crossing until he fell from his horse and died.
translations.idiomatic: The troops panicked and tried to scatter; Guoxi roared them back into line, led the fight in person, and was cut down under a storm of arrows and blades, falling dead from his horse.

sentences.zh: 撫按不奏，帝降旨嚴責，乃具聞，贈恤如制。

translations.literal: The provincial governor and surveillance commissioner did not report it; the emperor issued a stern rebuke, and only then did they submit a full account and grant posthumous honors according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The governor and surveillance commissioner had kept silent; only after the emperor rebuked them sharply did they file a full report and award posthumous honors as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 時大兵下山東，直抵海州、贛榆、沐陽、豐、沛，列城將吏，或遁或降。

translations.literal: At that time the great army descended on Shandong, reaching directly Haizhou, Ganyu, Shuyang, Feng, and Pei; commanders and officials of the cities either fled or surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The main Qing force swept down through Shandong as far as Haizhou, Ganyu, Shuyang, Feng, and Pei, and city after city saw its officers flee or capitulate.

sentences.zh: 其身死封疆者，有馮守禮、張百新、張予卿、朱迥添、任萬民等。

translations.literal: Among those who died in defense of their territory were Feng Shouli, Zhang Baixin, Zhang Yuqing, Zhu Jiongtian, Ren Wanmin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died holding their posts included Feng Shouli, Zhang Baixin, Zhang Yuqing, Zhu Jiongtian, Ren Wanmin, and others.

sentences.zh: 守禮，猗氏人，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: Shouli was a native of Yishi and passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shouli came from Yishi and had passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 縣令有疑獄，語訴者得馮孝廉一剌，獄即解。

translations.literal: The magistrate had a doubtful case; he told the plaintiff that one note from Feng the Filial and Incorrupt would settle it, and the case was resolved.
translations.idiomatic: When the county magistrate faced a difficult case, he told the litigant that a single note from Feng the Filial and Incorrupt would resolve it — and it did.

sentences.zh: 其人懷金以告，拒不聽。

translations.literal: That man came bearing gold to inform him, but he refused to listen.
translations.idiomatic: The man tried to bring him gold in thanks, but he would not accept it.

sentences.zh: 選平定州學正，諸生兄弟爭彥相訐，饋以金，守禮嚴卻之，勸以友悌，感悟去。

translations.literal: Selected as director of studies at Pingding Prefecture, when student brothers quarreled and slandered each other he was offered gold; Shouli sternly refused it, exhorted them to brotherly harmony, and they left moved to repentance.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen director of studies at Pingding, he found two student brothers feuding and slandering each other; when they tried to bribe him with gold he refused outright, urged them toward fraternity, and they withdrew ashamed and reconciled.

sentences.zh: 歷遷知萊蕪縣。

translations.literal: He was eventually transferred to serve as magistrate of Laiwu County.
translations.idiomatic: He was later promoted to magistrate of Laiwu.

sentences.zh: 城破，與二子攄奇、拱奇並自殺。

translations.literal: When the city fell, he and his two sons Shuqi and Gongqi all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When the city was lost, he and his sons Shuqi and Gongqi took their own lives together.

sentences.zh: 日新，浙江建德人。

translations.literal: Zhang Rixin was a native of Jiande in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rixin came from Jiande in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 由歲貢為訓導，造齊東教諭。

translations.literal: Through annual tribute selection he became an assistant instructor and was appointed instructor at Qidong.
translations.idiomatic: Selected through the annual tribute route, he served as assistant instructor and was then appointed instructor at Qidong.

sentences.zh: 見海內寇起，與諸生講藝習射，招土寇安守夏降之。

translations.literal: Seeing banditry rise across the realm, he lectured students on the classics and practiced archery, and recruited the local bandit An Shouxia to submit.
translations.idiomatic: As rebellion spread across the empire, he drilled his students in the classics and archery and persuaded the local bandit An Shouxia to surrender.

sentences.zh: 及齊東被圍，與守夏登陴守，力屈及子光裔死之，妻方氏自刎，守夏亦從死。

translations.literal: When Qidong was besieged, he and Shouxia mounted the walls to defend; exhausted in the fight, he died together with his son Guangyi; his wife, Lady Fang, cut her own throat; Shouxia followed him in death.
translations.idiomatic: When Qidong came under siege, he and Shouxia took to the battlements; worn down in the defense, he died with his son Guangyi, his wife Lady Fang slit her throat, and Shouxia died with them.

sentences.zh: 予卿知陽信，城陷殉難。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuqing served as magistrate of Yangxin and died martyred when the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuqing was magistrate of Yangxin and died defending the city when it fell.

sentences.zh: 迥添者，瀋陽宗室也，居潞安。

translations.literal: Jiongtian was of the imperial clan of Shenyang and lived in Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jiongtian belonged to the Shenyang branch of the imperial clan and made his home in Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 由宗學貢生為鄒平知縣，城失，全節以死。

translations.literal: Through the imperial clan school tribute he became magistrate of Zouping; when the city was lost he preserved his integrity unto death.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute graduate of the imperial clan school, he served as magistrate of Zouping and, when the city fell, died without compromise.

sentences.zh: 萬民，陽曲諸生。

translations.literal: Wanmin was a student from Yangqu.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Wanmin was a licentiate of Yangqu.

sentences.zh: 見鄉郡被寇，草救時八議、守城十二策，獻之當事，果得其用。

translations.literal: Seeing his home region ravaged by bandits, he drafted eight proposals for urgent relief and twelve strategies for defending cities, presented them to the authorities, and they proved useful.
translations.idiomatic: When his native region was overrun, he drafted eight urgent proposals and twelve plans for city defense, submitted them to the authorities, and they were put to good use.

sentences.zh: 以保舉授武城知縣，在職三年，有能聲，竟殉城死。

translations.literal: Through recommendation for preservation he was appointed magistrate of Wucheng; after three years in office he had a reputation for competence and ultimately died martyred defending the city.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended for his talents, he was made magistrate of Wucheng; in three years he earned a name for ability, and in the end died holding the walls.

sentences.zh: 又文昌時，全州舉人。

translations.literal: Also Wen Changshi, a provincial graduate of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Wen Changshi, a juren from Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 知臨淄縣，以廉慎得民。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Linzi and won the people through integrity and caution.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Linzi he won the people's trust through probity and care.

sentences.zh: 及大清兵東下，城受圍，與訓導申周輔共守。

translations.literal: When the Great Qing army marched east, the city was besieged, and he defended it together with Assistant Instructor Shen Zhoufu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qing army swept eastward and the city came under siege, he held the walls alongside Assistant Instructor Shen Zhoufu.

sentences.zh: 城破，舉家自焚，周輔亦殉難。

translations.literal: When the city fell, his whole household burned themselves; Zhoufu also died martyred.
translations.idiomatic: When the city was lost, his entire family burned themselves to death, and Zhoufu died with them.

sentences.zh: 同時，壽光知縣李耿，大興人。

translations.literal: At the same time Li Geng, magistrate of Shouguang, was a native of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Li Geng, magistrate of Shouguang, came from Daxing.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中進士，自縊城上。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the Chongzhen era, he hanged himself atop the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: A Chongzhen-era jinshi, he hanged himself on the city wall.

sentences.zh: 吳良能，遼東蓋州人。

translations.literal: Wu Liangneng was a native of Gaizhou in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Liangneng came from Gaizhou in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，知滕縣，城將破，盡殺家屬，拜母出，力戰死。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination and served as magistrate of Teng County; when the city was about to fall he killed all his family members, bowed to his mother and went out, and died fighting fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he was magistrate of Teng; as the city was about to fall he put his entire household to death, bowed farewell to his mother, went out, and died fighting.

sentences.zh: 吳汝宗，寧洋人。

translations.literal: Wu Ruzong was a native of Ningyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ruzong came from Ningyang.

sentences.zh: 知東阿，城失守，死之。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Dong'e; when the city was lost he died.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Dong'e, he died when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 周啟元，黃岡舉人，知高苑縣，城破，朱衣坐堂上，死之。

translations.literal: Zhou Qiyuan, a provincial graduate of Huanggang, served as magistrate of Gaoyuan; when the city fell he sat on the dais in vermilion robes and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Qiyuan, a Huanggang juren and magistrate of Gaoyuan, when the city was lost seated himself on the bench in his official red robes and met his death there.

sentences.zh: 劉光先，未詳里居，知豐縣。

translations.literal: Liu Guangxian, whose place of origin is not recorded, served as magistrate of Feng County.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangxian, of unknown origin, was magistrate of Feng County.

sentences.zh: 大兵二千騎營西城外，不攻。

translations.literal: Two thousand cavalry of the great army encamped outside the west gate and did not attack.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand Qing horsemen camped outside the west gate without attacking.

sentences.zh: 夜一人自營逸出，語城上人曰：「得梯即攻。

translations.literal: At night one man escaped from the camp and told those atop the wall: "Once they get ladders they will attack at once."
translations.idiomatic: That night a man slipped out of the enemy camp and called up to the wall: "As soon as they have ladders, they'll attack."

sentences.zh: 」不信。

translations.literal: " They did not believe him.
translations.idiomatic: " No one believed it.

sentences.zh: 又有逸者曰：「梯成，立攻矣。

translations.literal: Another escapee said: "The ladders are finished; they will attack immediately."
translations.idiomatic: Another fugitive from the camp said, "The ladders are ready — they'll attack at once."

sentences.zh: 」婦人亦自營出曰：「盡甲矣。

translations.literal: " A woman also came out from the camp and said: "They are all in armor."
translations.idiomatic: " A woman too came from the camp and cried, "They're all armored up."

sentences.zh: 」昧爽突攻西南陬，方力禦，已登西北陬，光先殉焉。

translations.literal: " At dawn they suddenly attacked the southwest corner; just as the defenders were resisting there, the enemy had already scaled the northwest corner, and Guangxian died martyred.
translations.idiomatic: " At first light they stormed the southwest corner; while the defenders strained to hold there, the enemy were already over the northwest wall, and Guangxian fell.

sentences.zh: 劉士璟，亦不知何許人，知沐陽，有強幹聲。
